description: Show a map's tiles as text so you can check what you painted. mode 'symbols' (default) draws one character per cell using the topmost tile of layers 0-3 (or only `layer`) with a legend naming each symbol; mode 'ids' prints raw tile ids of one layer. Use x/y/width/height to look at a region (default: up to 100x60 from the top-left).
name: render_map
title: Render map as text
